moves.why: Key word 'go abroad': a traveller with her passport in a ferry terminal, no beach or sea holiday in the clip. Countries is defined as 'being a foreigner abroad' and already holds both 'abroad' videos (4579, 5510). Beach keeps 9 at A.

names.why: About half of the 29 videos are harbours, ferries, ships, yachts, a marina, a lighthouse and a pier, not a beach; 'Seaside' covers both halves.

Only about 10 of 40 videos show camping (tent, campfire, camper van); about 24 are hiking, mountains, trails and viewpoints. 'Hiking' covers more; 'Outdoors' would cover all 40 but I propose it for 1202.

notes: Borderline, not moved: 4047 'holiday' (couple on a daybed at a beach resort with the sea behind) would fit Beach beside 'be on holiday' and 'go on holiday', and Hotel would keep 6 at A; 5051 'lose' (hostel dorm, emptied backpack) could be Luggage; 7563 'set off' (motorbike with sidecar) and 4906 'tent' (party tent in a garden) have no better group. 4635/4636 are twin clips split between Station and Beach by key word, which is right.
